answer: Mechanism: Prism-Knoll Sequential Pearl (PKSP). Each agent identity is a pearl formed by completing an unpredictable dependency chain: every step hashes the prior pearl with a fresh challenge from a public knoll—a rotating set of audited task roots. A prism check requires three independent verifiers to cross-validate the chain and reject shared prefixes. Scarce resource: wall-clock sequential work and distinct attention, not capital. A sybil must run separate chains per identity; batching or replay collapses at the prism check, costing N× elapsed time and verifier attention.
